devdoc.details: Smart Vault contract where funds are being held offering a bunch of primitives to allow users model any type of action to manage them, these are: collector, withdraw, swap, bridge, join, exit, bridge, wrap, and unwrap. It inherits from InitializableAuthorizedImplementation which means it's implementation can be cloned from the Mimic Registry and should be initialized depending on each case.

authorize(address,bytes4).details: Authorizes someone to call a function. Sender must be authorize to do so.

params.amount: Amount of tokens to be bridged
params.data: Encoded data to specify different bridge parameters depending on the source picked
params.limitAmount: Amount of the swap limit to be applied depending on limitType
params.limitType: Bridge limit to be applied: slippage or min amount out
params.recipient: Address that will receive the tokens on the destination chain
params.source: Source to request the bridge. It depends on the Bridge Connector attached to a Smart Vault.
params.token: Address of the token to be bridged

returns.bridged: Amount requested to be bridged after fees

call(address,bytes,uint256,bytes).details: Execute an arbitrary call from a Smart Vault. Sender must be authorized.

params.data: Calldata to be used for the call
params.target: Address where the call will be sent
params.value: Value in wei that will be attached to the call

returns.result: Call response if it was successful, otherwise it reverts

claim(address,bytes).details: Claim strategy rewards. Sender must be authorized.

params.data: Extra data passed to the strategy and logged
params.strategy: Address of the strategy to claim rewards

returns.amounts: Amounts of the tokens received as rewards
returns.tokens: Addresses of the tokens received as rewards

collect(address,address,uint256,bytes).details: Collect tokens from an external account to a Smart Vault. Sender must be authorized.

params.amount: Amount of tokens to be transferred
params.from: Address where the tokens will be transfer from
params.token: Address of the token to be collected

constructor.details: Creates a new Smart Vault implementation with references that should be shared among all implementations

params._registry: Address of the Mimic Registry to be referenced
params._wrappedNativeToken: Address of the wrapped native token to be used

exit(address,address[],uint256[],uint256.details: Exit a strategy. Sender must be authorized.

params.amountsIn: List of token amounts to exit with
params.data: Extra data passed to the strategy and logged
params.slippage: Slippage that will be used to compute the exit
params.strategy: Address of the strategy to exit
params.tokensIn: List of token addresses to exit with

returns.amountsOut: List of token amounts received after the exit
returns.tokensOut: List of token addresses received after the exit

getPrice(address,address).details: Tells the price of a token (base) in a given quote

params.quote: Token used for the price rate

getPriceFeed(address,address).details: Tells the price feed address for (base, quote) pair. It returns the zero address if there is no one set.

params.quote: Token used for the price rate

params.admin: Address that will be granted with admin rights

isAuthorized(address,bytes4).details: Tells whether someone is allowed to call a function or not. It returns true if it's allowed to anyone.

join(address,address[],uint256[],uint256.details: Join a strategy with an amount of tokens. Sender must be authorized.

params.amountsIn: List of token amounts to join with
params.data: Extra data passed to the strategy and logged
params.slippage: Slippage that will be used to compute the join
params.strategy: Address of the strategy to join
params.tokensIn: List of token addresses to join with

returns.amountsOut: List of token amounts received after the join
returns.tokensOut: List of token addresses received after the join

lastValue(address).details: Tells the last value accrued for a strategy. Note this value can be outdated.

params.strategy: Address of the strategy querying the last value of

setBridgeConnector(address).details: Sets a new bridge connector to a Smart Vault. Sender must be authorized.

params.newBridgeConnector: Address of the new bridge connector to be set

setBridgeFee(uint256,uint256,address,uin.details: Sets a new bridge fee. Sender must be authorized.

params.cap: New maximum amount of bridge fees to be charged per period
params.pct: New bridge fee percentage to be set
params.period: New cap period length in seconds for the bridge fee
params.token: Address of the token cap to be set

setFeeCollector(address).details: Sets a new fee collector. Sender must be authorized.

params.newFeeCollector: Address of the new fee collector to be set

setPerformanceFee(uint256,uint256,addres.details: Sets a new performance fee. Sender must be authorized.

params.cap: New maximum amount of performance fees to be charged per period
params.pct: Performance fee percentage to be set
params.period: New cap period length in seconds for the performance fee
params.token: Address of the token cap to be set

setPriceFeeds(address[],address[],addres.details: Sets a list of price feeds. Sender must be authorized.

params.bases: List of token bases to be set
params.feeds: List of price feeds to be set
params.quotes: List of token quotes to be set

setPriceOracle(address).details: Sets a new price oracle to a Smart Vault. Sender must be authorized.

params.newPriceOracle: Address of the new price oracle to be set

setStrategy(address,bool).details: Sets a new strategy as allowed or not for a Smart Vault. Sender must be authorized.

params.allowed: Whether the strategy is allowed or not
params.strategy: Address of the strategy to be set

setSwapConnector(address).details: Sets a new swap connector to a Smart Vault. Sender must be authorized.

params.newSwapConnector: Address of the new swap connector to be set

setSwapFee(uint256,uint256,address,uint2.details: Sets a new swap fee. Sender must be authorized.

params.cap: New maximum amount of swap fees to be charged per period
params.pct: New swap fee percentage to be set
params.period: New cap period length in seconds for the swap fee
params.token: Address of the token cap to be set

setWithdrawFee(uint256,uint256,address,u.details: Sets a new withdraw fee. Sender must be authorized.

params.cap: New maximum amount of withdraw fees to be charged per period
params.pct: Withdraw fee percentage to be set
params.period: New cap period length in seconds for the withdraw fee
params.token: Address of the token cap to be set

swap(uint8,address,address,uint256,uint8.details: Swaps two tokens. Sender must be authorized.

params.data: Encoded data to specify different swap parameters depending on the source picked
params.limitAmount: Amount of the swap limit to be applied depending on limitType
params.limitType: Swap limit to be applied: slippage or min amount out
params.source: Source to request the swap: Uniswap V2, Uniswap V3, Balancer V2, or Paraswap V5.

unauthorize(address,bytes4).details: Unauthorizes someone to call a function. Sender must be authorize to do so.

unwrap(uint256,bytes).details: Unwrap an amount of wrapped native tokens. Sender must be authorized.

params.amount: Amount of wrapped native tokens to unwrapped

withdraw(address,uint256,address,bytes).details: Withdraw tokens to an external account. Sender must be authorized.

params.recipient: Address where the tokens will be transferred to
params.token: Address of the token to be withdrawn

returns.withdrawn: Amount of tokens transferred to the recipient address

wrap(uint256,bytes).details: Wrap an amount of native tokens to the wrapped ERC20 version of it. Sender must be authorized.

params.amount: Amount of native tokens to be wrapped

NAMESPACE.details: Tells the namespace under which the implementation is registered in the Mimic Registry

bridgeConnector.details: Tells the bridge connector associated to a Smart Vault

feeCollector.details: Tells the address where fees will be deposited

investedValue.details: Tells the invested value for a strategy

params.strategy: Address of the strategy querying the invested value of

isStrategyAllowed.details: Tells a strategy is allowed or not

params.strategy: Address of the strategy being queried

priceOracle.details: Tells the price oracle associated to a Smart Vault

swapConnector.details: Tells the swap connector associated to a Smart Vault

wrappedNativeToken.details: Tells the address of the wrapped native token

devdoc.title: Smart Vault
